test_title: PYST 22: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Refer to the following series and answer the question that follows (all numbers are single digit numbers only). Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) 7 8 5 9 6 5 4 1 7 1 6 7 8 6 6 3 5 3 6 9 4 4 9 2 7 2 7 (Right)

How many such even numbers are there each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number?15230
solution:
**Given:** (Left) 7 8 5 9 6 5 4 1 7 1 6 7 8 6 6 3 5 3 6 9 4 4 9 2 7 2 7 (Right)

Now,

Even numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number.

So, the needed pattern is: Odd — Even — Odd

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e984b705bc453e7669cc11a01096648114ecc3d4e281839dfff2f1955f49366.png] 

Thus, there are 7 even numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".
